pred_texts: Instruct: Get two slices of bread and toast them in the toaster until nice and crisp, for about one minute.
Instruct: Now put the toasts on a microwave-safe plate.
Instruct: Now spread about two tablespoons of pizza sauce on each slice of bread.
Instruct: Now spread the pizza sauce evenly on each slice of bread.
Instruct: Now sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese on one slice of bread, enough to cover it fully.
Instruct: Now you can add any toppings that you want on top of the cheese.
Instruct: Now you can close the sandwich and then microwave it for 45 to 60 seconds to make sure that the cheese is melted.
